title: Hospital Bed Management Application
description: An application for hospital search, bed availability, and booking workflows. Patient-facing screens connect to REST APIs with form validation, loading states, navigation, and clear error handling.

title: EnterpriseFlow – Workflow Management SaaS
description: A workflow management platform bringing tasks, assignments, and progress tracking into one workspace. A React interface and FastAPI services connect team workflows to structured PostgreSQL data.

title: Personalized Retail Product Recommendation Engine
description: A recommendation engine that uses collaborative filtering to connect shoppers with relevant products. Python models process customer–product interactions, with SQL data access and a REST API for integration.

title: AI-Powered Business Process Intelligence & Decision Support Platform
description: A platform for exploring business process data and supporting operational decisions. Pandas data processing, machine learning, and PostgreSQL combine with FastAPI endpoints and a containerized application setup.

title: Enterprise LAN Design with VLAN Segmentation & Inter-VLAN Routing
description: An enterprise network design using VLANs to separate departments and inter-VLAN routing to support controlled communication. Cisco Packet Tracer and IOS CLI provide a reproducible environment for configuring and checking connectivity.

title: Secure Small-Office Network – NAT, ACL & DHCP Automation
description: A small-office network combining automated address assignment, network address translation, and access control lists. The design focuses on practical connectivity, traffic restrictions, and repeatable Cisco IOS configuration.

title: AI-Powered Retail Demand Forecasting & Inventory Optimization
description: A retail analytics project using historical sales data to forecast demand and inform inventory planning. Pandas supports data preparation, with XGBoost and Scikit-learn for predictive modeling and evaluation.

title: Weather Web Application
description: A responsive weather application using OpenWeatherMap and browser location capabilities. Search for a city or use a location-based workflow to explore current weather with clear loading and error states.

title: Modular Task Management & Workflow Automation System
description: A modular task management system supporting task creation, assignments, priorities, and status tracking. Layered Spring Boot services, REST APIs, and MySQL organize the application; JUnit and Mockito cover business logic and validation.
